marc:datafield.marc:subfield: THE HERO'S GUIDE TO STORMING THE CASTLE

Prince Liam. Prince Frederick. Prince Duncan. Prince Gustav. You've never heard of them, but you've probably heard of Prince Charming, the guy who rides in at the last minute to save the girl. Well that's them, all four of them. They are all Prince Charmings. Only in reality, they are a little less heroic than you might expect. When Prince Liam is kidnapped and forced to marry the evil Briar Rose, they must unite again to save him. But can they really overcome their differences for long enough to save the day again? With The Bandit King, an evil warlord, and Briar Rose all working against them, they may need a little help from the Princesses this time.
